The watch is a Patek Philippe Aquanaut — it has the cushion-shaped case, black dial with grid pattern, orange seconds hand, chronograph pushers... Wait, this is the Patek Philippe Aquanaut Chronograph 5968A? No — 5968A has an orange/green... Let me think.

The Aquanaut Chronograph 5968A-001 has a black dial with orange accents and orange seconds hand, on a black rubber strap. Yes! Reference 5968A-001: steel, black dial with orange details, black rubber strap, self-winding chronograph flyback, caliber CH 28-520 C. The date window shows 31 at 3 o'clock. The subdial at 6 o'clock is the 60-minute counter with orange hand. The case diameter 42.2 mm.

Actually, the 5968A-001 has an orange central chronograph hand and orange accents; the strap is orange and black included. The 5968A-001 comes with both orange and black straps.

Here the strap is black rubber. The reference 5968A-001 is steel. Yes.

But wait — is there a newer version, 5968G (white gold) with green or blue dial? 5968G-001 is white gold with blue dial. 5968A-001 is steel with black dial with orange.

The photo shows a steel case (looks steel, polished), black dial, orange accents. So 5968A-001.

Model family: Aquanaut Chronograph.

Movement: automatic (self-winding chronograph, CH 28-520 C).

Case material: stainless-steel.

Bracelet material: rubber (black rubber strap).

Reference number format: Patek 5968A-001. Format is four digits then letter, then hyphen-three digits. Yes.

Confidence: high, ~0.85.

Note: the strap on the watch — Patek 5968A-001 uses a "Tropical" composite rubber strap. So bracelet_material: rubber.
